components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:

          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string

          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

      properties:

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:

          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255

Done. The telephone handling is now E.164, and the full test suite is green (3/3 acceptance tests pass).

## What changed

The telephone rule lived in one helper used by both the validator and the duplicate-checker, so the core change was a single algorithm swap plus loosening the persistence constraints that hard-coded "10 digits".

1. **`OwnerTelephone.java`** — replaced `normalize` (strip to bare digits, require 10) with `toE164(String)`, the single source of truth:
   - strips spaces, dashes and brackets;
   - if the cleaned value starts with `+`, keeps that `+` and country code;
   - otherwise assumes `+61`, dropping a single leading `0` from the national digits;
   - requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, returning `null` otherwise.
   - So `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`.

2. **`ValidateOwnerFields.java`** (POST pipeline) — now calls `toE164`; a `null` result adds a `telephone` error → **400** via the existing `OwnerFieldsInvalidException` handler. The E.164 string replaces the submitted value, so it's what gets stored and returned.

3. **`CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique.java`** — duplicate detection now compares E.164 values (both request and each stored owner run through `toE164`).

4. **`Owner.java`** (entity) — the telephone `@Pattern`/`@Digits` enforced `^[0-9]{10}$`, which Hibernate validates on persist and would have rejected the E.164 value. Changed to `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` and dropped the now-unused `@Digits` import.

5. **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `telephone` schema's description/example/pattern to describe the E.164 input-and-storage contract (the generated DTO is `@Valid`-checked on the PUT path).

### Verification
`AcceptanceTest` (the only test class, so the whole suite) — **Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0**: national→E.164, explicit-country-code preserved, and unformattable `"12"` rejected with 400.
